channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Glydways proposes elevated self-driving transit connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based autonomous transit company is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport. Glydways will present the proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for initial consideration.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. Riviera Beach was the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents demand fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as dispute heads to budget talks
item.description: A missing fence at the JB-7 public beach access point is creating tension between Colony Condos residents and beachgoers. The town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons, and residents say people are now cutting through their private property.

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third straight A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County earned an A rating from the state for the third year in a row. S.D. Spady Elementary School made a dramatic leap from a C rating last year to an A this year.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida roads
item.description: A record number of Americans are traveling this Fourth of July weekend, and South Florida drivers are feeling it. AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans will have traveled at least 50 miles from home between Saturday, June 27 and Sunday, July 5.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% as ground beef and strawberries see biggest increases
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5%, and strawberries, hit hard by a Florida frost, are up 12.4%.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is opposing a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy since 2009, who was suspended following controversial Facebook comments about Charlie Kirk. item.title: Port St. Lucie advances Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road with 7-acre land transfer
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike. The city is working on multiple phases of the $95 million Midway Road Widening Project.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce offers tours, art classes and artist residencies
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce is transforming the city into an artistic destination. The non-profit organization preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain in the historic Crain Estate and connects local and international artists.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4 percent this year, ground beef and buns see biggest increases
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5 percent and buns are up 7.7 percent.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday. The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit responded to reports of a small motorized boat taking on water and becoming submerged on July 1.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation to nearly double capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation project expected to be completed by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday after injuring her right knee during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state championship after 10-2 season and district title
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is preparing for the 2026 fall season with their sights set on a state championship. item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach Country Club Hosts Fourth of July Fireworks and Pool Party
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors celebrated Independence Day with family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Florida State Parks waive admission fees through Sunday for America's 250th anniversary
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection waived admission fees at state parks from Friday, July 3, through Sunday, July 5, to celebrate America's 250th birthday.

item.title: DeSantis signs $117.6 billion state budget with $810 million in vetoes
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a $117.6 billion state budget this week, marking the fourth consecutive year of shrinking spending plans in Florida. item.title: Southwest Florida communities celebrate America's 250th with fireworks and parades
item.description: Fourth of July weekend brought fireworks, parades, drone shows and waterfront celebrations across Southwest Florida as communities marked America's 250th birthday.

item.title: North Port celebrates Independence Day at CoolToday Park with Freedom Festival
item.description: CoolToday Park hosted North Port's Independence Day celebration with patriotic entertainment, family activities, food vendors, live music and fireworks.

item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is establishing Fort Pierce as an artistic destination by maintaining the historic Crain Estate and supporting the Peacock Arts District.
